text:
anya: Quick UX question — need a decision on inline errors vs. top-level summary for the "Dataset create" modal. Current mock uses inline red text + icons, but there's an a11y flag that screen readers don't always announce inline updates. Thoughts? marco: I vote for hybrid: inline for individual fields, and a compact summary at the top when there are 2+ errors. Summary should be keyboard-focusable and link to first error. :+1: leila: Agreed on hybrid. Also want to standardize the required-field treatment. Asterisk alone isn't sufficient for screen readers. We should include hidden text e.g. visually-hidden "required" or use aria-required on inputs. samir: Re: summary behavior — if the summary is shown, focus should move there automatically and include a short message like "3 errors — press Tab to jump to first" so users know what's next. For voiceover we can use an assertive aria-live as well. eden: On destructive actions (related to the form flows) — copy/context matters. For deleting datasets I prefer typed-confirm for prod datasets, but a simple checkbox + "Delete" for small/test datasets. We should define thresholds (e.g., "prod tag" or size > 1GB) not just eyeballing. anya: Good call. For the modal copy, lean toward explicit verbs: instead of "This cannot be undone" use "Permanently delete dataset and associated artifacts." More specific helps decisioning. leila: Accessibility nit: ensure errors are announced with role="alert" or aria-live="assertive" when they appear. Example snippet for the summary:```
There are 3 errors. Review the highlighted fields.
``` Also link the summary to fields with aria-describedby or an anchor so screen readers can jump. marco: Mobile note — the top summary takes vertical space. For mobile collapse it into a single-line pill: "3 errors — review" that expands on tap. Inline errors remain below fields. samir: Also consider error wording: prefer action-oriented copy — "Enter a name for the dataset" vs "Name missing". Actionable language reduces friction. eden: For destructive typed confirm, agreed on scope rules. My proposal: require typed-confirm for any dataset with (a) "production" tag OR (b) size >= 1GB OR (c) has >1 downstream consumers. Otherwise show checkbox + additional confirmation copy. @product should own the exact thresholds. anya: Quick implementation notes for eng: we'll need a small UX component for the top summary that exposes focus(), aria-live, and a link to the first invalid field id. Also add a design token for required marker accessible label. ui-bot: Accessibility checklist added to PR #4032: missing aria-live on error summary, no aria-required on required inputs, and required-markers lacking sr-only fallback. leila: TL;DR / decision: hybrid error pattern (inline + top summary for 2+ errors with focus + aria-live announcement), required fields: visible asterisk + sr-only "required" text + aria-required=true, destructives: typed confirm for prod/large/downstream datasets, checkbox otherwise. I'll update the spec and mock. anya: Perfect — I'll schedule a quick review tomorrow to sign off on copy and mobile layout. Thanks all :heart:
